checks.label: Press Mara for the truth
checks.success: Mara admits the Emberglass is part of a protective seal and identifies Bellweather Priory.
checks.failure: She still names the priory but withholds the seal's purpose; Tamsin can reveal the alternate route.

checks.label: Calm the memory-struck travelers
checks.success: They remember pale mist drifting from the priory and reveal clue-spirit-nature.
checks.failure: They scatter, but tracks and cold mist still point toward the priory; no required clue is lost.

checks.label: Read the chalk wards
checks.success: The marks are protective and recently renewed by Caldus.
checks.failure: The marks remain obviously fresh; Caldus or his notes can reveal their purpose later.

checks.label: Advance the replacement binding
checks.failure: No progress; the acting character takes 1d6 psychic damage from the Guest's whispers.

checks.label: Negotiate with the Pale Guest
checks.success: Gain 1 bargain success; 3 before 2 failures produces a binding bargain.
checks.failure: Gain 1 bargain failure and the Guest immediately uses Whispering Theft against the speaker.

encounters.objective: Cross the yard or neutralize the guardians.
encounters.start: Four Thornbound Grave-Things rise when a creature moves more than 10 feet into the yard.
encounters.bypass: Characters who know the culvert can skip this encounter. A DC 12 Dexterity (Stealth) group check also crosses the grave edge without waking them; on failure combat starts with the Grave-Things 20 feet away.

creatures.name: Thornbound Grave-Thing
creatures.attack: Thorn Claw. Melee +4 to hit, reach 5 ft.; 1d6+2 slashing.
creatures.trait: Rooted Dead. Difficult terrain caused by plants does not slow it. It never pursues beyond the priory yard.
creatures.tactics: Attack the nearest intruder. If fire damages one, that creature attacks the source of the fire on its next turn.

encounters.end: Combat ends when all guardians are destroyed or no conscious party member remains in the yard. Fleeing into the chapel ends pursuit.

encounters.objective: Keep the revelation available even if talks collapse.
encounters.start: Caldus begins 25 feet away and does not attack first.

creatures.name: Brother Caldus
creatures.attack: Ash Staff. Melee +4 to hit; 1d6+2 bludgeoning plus 1d4 fire.
creatures.ranged: Ember Bolt. Ranged spell attack +5, range 60 ft.; 2d8 fire.
creatures.reaction: Warding Spark (1/round). Add +2 AC against one attack that would hit him.
creatures.tactics: Disengages toward the ritual chamber when below 18 HP. He calls out the truth about the seal every round and surrenders rather than fight to the death.

encounters.end: At 8 HP or fewer Caldus yields if given the chance. If reduced to 0 HP, his journal beside the Emberglass reveals clue-real-seal and clue-caldus-plan.

encounters.objective: Survive while choosing destruction, binding, or bargain.
encounters.start: The Guest appears at the far side of the 40-foot ritual chamber. Roll initiative immediately after the read-aloud.

creatures.name: The Pale Guest
creatures.resistances: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
creatures.attack: Memory Rend. Melee +6 to hit, reach 10 ft.; 2d8+3 psychic.
creatures.action: Whispering Theft. One creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save; on failure it takes 3d6 psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll or ability check. Half damage and no disadvantage on success.
creatures.trait: Unstable Binding. At initiative count 20, one unoccupied sigil flares. A creature adjacent to it may use its reaction to make DC 12 Intelligence (Arcana or Religion); success suppresses the flare, failure or no attempt deals 1d6 psychic damage to every creature within 10 ft. of that sigil.
creatures.tactics: Targets whoever most recently advanced the ritual or bargain. It does not leave the chamber while the Emberglass remains intact.

encounters.ritual: The replacement binding needs 3 ritual successes before 3 ritual failures. One character adjacent to a sigil can use an action for check-ritual. Caldus contributes one automatic success at the end of round 2 if conscious and allied. At 3 successes, the Guest is bound and combat ends.
encounters.destroy: A creature holding the Emberglass may use an action to smash it against the central stone. The Guest loses its nonmagical weapon resistance and cannot be bound afterward.
encounters.bargain: A character can use an action for check-bargain. Three bargain successes before two failures ends hostilities, but the party must offer one meaningful memory from each willing bargainer; record the memories as story consequences.
encounters.end: 0 HP destroys the Guest; 3 ritual successes bind it; 3 bargain successes create a new pact.

hazards.trigger: A character rings the hanging handbell.
hazards.failure: Take 2d6 psychic damage and forget the last minute until finishing a short rest; the player still retains all discovered clues and game information.
hazards.success: Half damage and no memory loss.
hazards.failForward: The crypt stair opens either way.

rewards.reward: Mara pays the promised 200 gp total even if the Emberglass is not returned.

rewards.when: The party searches the crypt after resolving the finale.
rewards.reward: A hidden votive box contains 80 gp in old silver and two 50 gp moonstones.

rewards.when: The party completes the new binding without destroying the Emberglass.
rewards.reward: Each surviving character gains Ember's Resolve: once before the next long rest, add 1d4 to a failed Wisdom saving throw, then the blessing ends.

features: culvert entrance outside east wall if discovered
outer darkness is solid wall, not an exit
